data.reason_zh: 共享可执行栈作为持久改进单元，执行轨迹驱动修复，验收后冻结复用于新任务，符合方法类RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Source-side execution traces guide failure attribution and the generation of missing tools or repairs to existing shared components.
scope_support.object_quote: We introduce Recursia, a recursive self-improvement framework that treats the shared executable stack, rather than individual task programs, as the persistent unit of improvement.
scope_support.persistence_quote: The resulting stack is frozen and reused through declarative task adapters, allowing source-derived changes to support new compositions without target-side code repair.
